symptoms.title: Large oval or diamond-shaped spots
symptoms.description: Lesions expand into pale- to medium-brown oval, elongated, or diamond-shaped patches, often near leaf margins or injured tissue.

symptoms.title: Bright yellow halo
symptoms.description: A clear bright-yellow band commonly surrounds the brown lesion and separates it from green leaf tissue.

symptoms.title: Pale center and zoned pattern
symptoms.description: As a lesion ages, its center may become light brown to whitish and may show concentric zones or a darker border.

symptoms.title: Lesions merge in severe cases
symptoms.description: Nearby spots can join into broad dead areas, especially on wet, damaged, or weakened leaves.

treatment.title: Confirm the leaf spot
treatment.description: Cordana can occur beside or resemble Sigatoka lesions. If spots are extensive or uncertain, contact the Sto. Tomas City Agriculture Office at (043) 784-8022 local 307 or agri@cityofstotomas.gov.ph.

treatment.title: Remove badly affected tissue
treatment.description: Prune severely affected portions with disinfected tools while retaining healthy leaf area. Keep removed material away from clean banana plants.

treatment.title: Correct moisture and plant stress
treatment.description: After wet weather, clear drainage, improve airflow, avoid injuring leaves, and correct water or nutrient stress that can favor Cordana infection.

treatment.title: Use products only with local advice
treatment.description: Apply a fungicide only after confirmation and only when the product is currently registered by the Philippine FPA for the crop and target disease. Follow the label exactly.

prevention.title: Reduce prolonged leaf wetness
prevention.description: Water near the soil when practical, keep drainage clear, and maintain spacing and airflow so foliage dries faster after rain.

prevention.title: Prevent injury and stress
prevention.description: Protect leaves from avoidable damage and maintain suitable irrigation and balanced nutrition because weakened tissue is more vulnerable.

prevention.title: Keep tools and plots clean
prevention.description: Disinfect pruning tools between plants and remove severely diseased tissue without carrying it into clean growing areas.

prevention.title: Inspect after humid or rainy weather
prevention.description: Pay close attention to older and injured leaves for enlarging brown spots with bright yellow halos, and act before lesions merge.
